resale_co.name: Certificate of Approval for Continued Occupancy (CACO)
resale_co.issued_by: City of Rahway Department of Code Enforcement, Division of Property Maintenance
resale_co.lead_time: Submit a complete application at least 2 to 3 weeks before closing; an inspector calls within 7 business days to schedule, and the report follows within about 5 business days
requirements: Exterior surfaces, foundation walls and roof sound and weather-tight
Stairs, porches, balconies and decks structurally sound; handrails on stairs over 4 risers and guardrails over 30 inches
Windows work and are glazed without cracks; insect screens on ventilation openings
Interior walls, ceilings and surfaces maintained (no peeling paint, loose plaster or decayed wood)
Sidewalks, driveways and aprons in good repair
Basements, cellars and crawl spaces reasonably dry
Plumbing installed and working without leaks
At least 2 outlets in each habitable room, kitchen outlets, light fixtures in halls, stairs, kitchen, bath, laundry and furnace room; GFCI within 6 feet of water

Smoke alarm on every level (including basements and finished attics), within 10 feet of bedroom doors; battery alarms 10-year sealed; hardwired not replaced with battery; alarms no more than 10 years old
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of sleeping areas; hardwired not replaced with battery
One portable fire extinguisher (2A:10BC, no more than 10 pounds, no more than 12 years old) within 10 feet of the kitchen (Rahway checklist)
Single family: building permits closed or resolved; two family: also a zoning permit before the CACO

fees.label: CACO, residential, per unit (includes the smoke and CO inspection for 1 and 2 unit homes)
Temporary CACO (TCACO), residential, per unit (additional fee when closing on a temporary certificate)
Included in the residential CACO fee, per unit (1 and 2 unit homes)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Certificates of Approval for Continued Occupancy (check Change of Ownership and Purchase/Sale) and e-mail a copy to propertymaintenance@cityofrahway.com or bring it to the office at One City Hall Plaza. Pay by check or money order to the City of Rahway before the inspection date. Two-family homes need a Zoning Permit first. If the home fails, the buyer can close with a Temporary CACO by signing a notarized affidavit and paying the TCACO fee, once all fire safety items pass.
resale_co.contact_title: Director of Code Enforcement / Construction Official (Property Maintenance Division office phone and email shown)

resale_co.notes: Fees are from the 2025 CACO application, set by Ordinance O-52-22 (effective 12/12/2022). Commercial is $200.00 per unit (CACO and TCACO). Rental properties built before 1978 are $125 per unit and get lead dust wipes; landlords must register and get a CACO in the tenant's name before move-in (rental requirement, not resale). Per the instructions table, a single-family CACO needs building permits closed or resolved; a two-family also needs a zoning permit; a separate Fire Department inspection is required only for 3 or more units and commercial. Frank Spallone's directory email is building@cityofrahway.com and his Code Enforcement phone is (732)827-2087.

requirements: Smoke alarm on every level including basements and finished attics, within 10 feet of bedroom doors; basement alarm at the base of the stairs
Battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed; hardwired alarms may not be replaced with battery alarms; alarms no more than 10 years old
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of any sleeping area (in the common area between bedrooms or in every bedroom)
One portable fire extinguisher (2A:10BC, no more than 10 pounds, no more than 12 years old, charged) visible within 10 feet of the kitchen (City checklist, undated)

fire_cert.notes: For 1 and 2 unit homes Rahway does the smoke and CO alarm check inside the CACO inspection, so there is no separate fire certificate fee published. Multi-family (3+) and commercial properties need a separate Fire Department inspection. The City's undated common-concerns checklist still requires a portable fire extinguisher; state law (P.L.2025, c.19) removed it from the state sale certificate in February 2025. The state fire directory lists Fire Official Steven P Niro, (732) 827-2133, sniro@cityofrahway.com.

other_items.label: Zoning permit (two family and up)
other_items.detail: Residential properties with 2 or more units must get a Zoning Permit before applying for a CACO.
